name: KV/Context Memory Mapping Roadmap
head: 30419c3d8

sdi_v0_1_1_endpoint.bounded_7b_result: WS-512 through WS-6144 passed clean, swap delta 0.0GB, no memory cliff found
sdi_v0_1_1_endpoint.why_paused: bounded 7B evidence complete for this backend; no diagnostic justification for more 7B runs

kv_context_questions.q: RAM as function of context length
kv_context_questions.known: Model weights ~5.3GB for 7B. KV grows with context but rate unknown on this machine.
Swap flat at ~0.37GB across all Phase 27H-J runs. Context length alone did not trigger swap within tested range. Runner state was dominant failure mode.

kv_context_questions.notes: /api/show returns model metadata only. Direct KV per-context data not available. External measurement via psutil is available.
No evidence that KV growth is the actual SDI performance bottleneck. No output quality degradation correlated with context length. Deep instrumentation not justified by current data.

safety_guard: max 18 runs (3 models x 3 contexts x 2 prompt types)
abort if swap pre > 1GB or delta > 250MB
stop on stuck runner, no retry

option_ranking.rationale: Lowest risk. Uses existing Ollama API + psutil.
Establish baseline on small models before 7B.
Extend Phase 27J with formal memory capture.

recommended_next: Phase 28B: external memory/context probe harness — small-model matrix (0.5B + 3B) at c=2048/4096/8192 with clean memory capture
